name: TablesOfAuthorities
description: A collection of TableOfAuthorities objects (TOA fields) that represents the tables of authorities in a document.
remarks: Use the TablesOfAuthorities property to return the TablesOfAuthorities collection. The following example applies the Classic built-in format to all the tables of authorities in the active document. Use the Add method to add a table of authorities to a document. A table of authorities is built from TA (Table of Authorities Entry) fields in a document. The following example adds a table of authorities that includes all categories at the beginning of the active document. Use TablesOfAuthorities (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single TableOfAuthorities object. The index number represents the position of the table of authorities in the document. The following example includes category headers in the first table of authorities in the active document and then updates the table.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TablesOfAuthorities object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of tables of authorities in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns or sets the formatting for the tables of authorities in the specified document. Read/write WdToaFormat.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual TableOfAuthorities object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Range As Range, [Category As Variant], [Bookmark As Variant], [Passim As Variant], [KeepEntryFormatting As Variant], [Separator As Variant], [IncludeSequenceName As Variant], [EntrySeparator As Variant], [PageRangeSeparator As Variant], [IncludeCategoryHeader As Variant], [PageNumberSeparator As Variant]) As TableOfAuthorities
methods.description: Returns a TableOfAuthorities object that represents a table of authorities added to a document.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The range where you want the table of authorities to appear. The table of authorities replaces the range, if the range isn't collapsed.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category of entries you want to include in the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \c switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. Values 0 through 16 correspond to the items listed in the Category box on the Table of Authorities tab in the Index and Tables dialog box (Reference command, Insert menu). The default value is 1.

parameters.name: Bookmark
parameters.description: The string name of the bookmark from which you want to collect entries for the table of authorities. If Bookmark is specified, the entries are collected only from the portion of the document marked by the bookmark. Corresponds to the \b switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field.

parameters.name: Passim
parameters.description: True to replace five or more page references to the same authority with Passim in the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \p switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If this argument is omitted, Passim is assumed to be False.

parameters.name: KeepEntryFormatting
parameters.description: True to apply formatting from table of authorities entries to the entries in the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \f switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If this argument is omitted, KeepEntryFormatting is assumed to be True.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The characters (up to five) between each sequence number and its page number in the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \d switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If argument is omitted, a hyphen (-) is used.

parameters.name: IncludeSequenceName
parameters.description: A string that specifies the Sequence (SEQ) field identifier for the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \s switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field.

parameters.name: EntrySeparator
parameters.description: The characters (up to five) that separate each entry and its page number in the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \e switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If this argument is omitted, no separator is used.

parameters.name: PageRangeSeparator
parameters.description: The characters (up to five) that separate the beginning and ending page numbers in each page range the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \g switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If this argument is omitted, an en dash is used.

parameters.name: IncludeCategoryHeader
parameters.description: True to have the category name for each group of entries appear in the table of authorities (for example, Cases). Corresponds to the \h switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If this argument is omitted, IncludeCategoryHeader is assumed to be True.

parameters.name: PageNumberSeparator
parameters.description: The characters (up to five) that separate individual page numbers within page references in the table of authorities. Corresponds to the \l switch for a Table of Authorities (TOA) field. If this argument is omitted, a comma and a space are used.

methods.name: NextCitation
methods.description: Finds and selects the next instance of the text specified by the ShortCitation parameter.

parameters.name: ShortCitation
parameters.description: The text of the short citation.

methods.name: MarkCitation
methods.signature: MarkCitation(Range As Range, ShortCitation As String, [LongCitation As Variant], [LongCitationAutoText As Variant], [Category As Variant]) As Field
methods.description: Inserts a TA (Table of Authorities Entry) field and returns the field as a Field object.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The location of the table of authorities entry. The TA field is inserted after Range.

parameters.name: ShortCitation
parameters.description: The short citation for the entry as it will appear in the Mark Citation dialog box (Insert menu, Index and Tables command).

parameters.name: LongCitation
parameters.description: The long citation for the entry as it will appear in the table of authorities.

parameters.name: LongCitationAutoText
parameters.description: The name of the AutoText entry that contains the text of the long citation as it will appear in the table of authorities.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category number to be associated with the entry: 1 corresponds to the first category in the Category box in the Mark Citation dialog box, 2 corresponds to the second category, and so on.

methods.name: MarkAllCitations
methods.signature: MarkAllCitations(ShortCitation As String, [LongCitation As Variant], [LongCitationAutoText As Variant], [Category As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts a TA (Table of Authorities Entry) field after all instances of the ShortCitation text.

parameters.name: ShortCitation
parameters.description: The short citation for the entry as it will appear in the Mark Citation dialog box (Insert menu, Index and Tables command).

parameters.name: LongCitation
parameters.description: The long citation string for the entry as it will appear in the table of authorities.

parameters.name: LongCitationAutoText
parameters.description: The AutoText entry name that contains the text of the long citation as it will appear in the table of authorities.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category number to be associated with the entry: 1 corresponds to the first category in the Category box in the Mark Citation dialog box, 2 corresponds to the second category, and so on.
